question: 如果一个请求经过 Location B，并且最终到达 Upstream B2，那么它必须经过以下哪个节点？

B. HTTP Server -> Location B -> Upstream B2 -> Response Plugin List B -> HTTP Response -> Logging

D. HTTP Server -> Location B -> Proxy Plugin List B -> Upstream B1 -> Response Plugin List B -> HTTP Response -> Logging

question: 以下哪个关于 Location A 和 Location B 的描述是不准确的？
options: A. 它们都直接连接到 HTTP Server
